title: Articles: a / an, the, no article
en:
a / an — one thing, first time we mention it, or a job: I work in a big company. She's an auditor. an before a vowel sound: an hour, an email, a university.

the — we both know which one; there is only one; second mention: Can you close the door? The director wants to see you. I read a report. The report was long.

No article — things in general (plural or uncountable): Safety is important. I like numbers. Also: at work, at home, go to bed, by car, on Monday, in 2025.
ru: a/an — один, впервые, профессия (an перед гласным звуком: an hour). the — понятно какой, единственный, уже упоминали. Без артикля — вообще (Safety is important), at work, at home, by car, on Monday.

boss.situation: Describe your company and your job in 5 sentences. Use a / an, the and no article at least once each.
samples: I work for an oil refinery in Atyrau.
The refinery is a subsidiary of a big national company.
I am a specialist in internal control.
The head of our department is very experienced.
I think safety is the most important thing at work.

qs.q: Can you open ___ window, please? It's hot.
qs.exp: We both know which window → the.

qs.q: ___ is very important in our industry.

qs.exp: hour starts with a vowel sound /aʊ/ → an.

qs.q: “I go to the work by bus” is correct.
qs.exp: at work / go to work — no article.

qs.q: “The sun rises in the east” uses the correctly.
I read a report yesterday. ___ report was very long.
